disease_actions.Tomato___Early_blight: Remove affected leaves and improve airflow. Apply an appropriate fungicide if the infection is spreading.
disease_actions.Tomato___Late_blight: Remove infected plant material and avoid overhead watering. Use an appropriate fungicide when necessary.
disease_actions.Tomato___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Potato___Early_blight: Remove affected leaves and maintain good field sanitation. Consider an appropriate fungicide if needed.
disease_actions.Potato___Late_blight: Remove infected material quickly and avoid overhead irrigation. Apply appropriate disease control measures.
disease_actions.Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot: Remove severely affected leaves and avoid overhead watering. Maintain field sanitation.
disease_actions.Pepper,_bell___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring.
disease_actions.Apple___Apple_scab: Remove infected leaves and fruit debris and improve airflow. Use appropriate fungicide management if needed.
disease_actions.Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew: Prune for better air circulation and apply a sulfur-based fungicide. Avoid overhead watering.
disease_actions.Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_: Apply a fungicide if rust pustules are spreading. Rotate crops next season to reduce recurrence.
disease_actions.Corn_(maize)___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Grape___Black_rot: Remove infected fruit and leaves immediately. Apply fungicide during wet periods and improve canopy airflow.
disease_actions.Grape___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Peach___Bacterial_spot: Remove and destroy infected leaves/fruit. Apply copper-based bactericide during dormant season.
disease_actions.Peach___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Potato___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Squash___Powdery_mildew: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate fungicide. Improve spacing for airflow and avoid overhead watering.
disease_actions.Strawberry___Leaf_scorch: Remove infected leaves and avoid overhead irrigation. Apply fungicide if spreading persists.
disease_actions.Strawberry___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Tomato___Bacterial_spot: Remove infected leaves, avoid overhead watering, and apply copper-based bactericide.
disease_actions.Tomato___Leaf_Mold: Improve greenhouse/field ventilation and reduce humidity. Apply fungicide if infection persists.
disease_actions.Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot: Remove affected lower leaves and apply fungicide. Avoid wetting foliage when watering.
disease_actions.Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider: Apply miticide or insecticidal soap. Increase humidity around plants to discourage mites.
disease_actions.Tomato___Target_Spot: Remove infected leaves and apply fungicide. Ensure adequate plant spacing for airflow.
disease_actions.Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus: Remove and destroy infected plants. Control whitefly populations, the primary vector, using insecticide or sticky traps.
disease_actions.Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately. Disinfect tools and avoid handling healthy plants after infected ones.

pest_actions.aphids: Inspect new growth and leaf undersides. Use physical removal or an appropriate pest-control method if infestation increases.
pest_actions.Thrips: Inspect flowers and young leaves. Remove heavily affected material and use appropriate integrated pest management.
pest_actions.corn borer: Inspect stems for entry holes and larvae. Remove severely affected plants and use appropriate pest management.
pest_actions.army worm: Inspect leaves for feeding damage and larvae. Remove visible larvae and use appropriate pest management if infestation increases.
pest_actions.peach borer: Inspect stems and trunk areas for borer damage. Remove affected material and use appropriate pest management.
pest_actions.flea beetle: Monitor leaf damage and use appropriate integrated pest management if damage becomes significant.
